description: Audit and format Sworn Affidavit of Continued Beneficial Homestead Occupancy to preserve 100% disabled veteran statutory property tax relief after deeding residence to a revocable living trust under T.C.A. § 67-5-704(g) and Tex. Tax Code § 11.13(j).

annual_property_tax_relief_usd.description: Annual statutory property tax relief amount to be preserved

deed_recording_date.description: Date deed to trust was recorded with County Register of Deeds (YYYY-MM-DD)

has_lifetime_occupancy_right.description: Whether trust instrument explicitly grants lifetime right of residential occupancy

trust_name.description: Full legal name of revocable living trust

veteran_is_primary_beneficiary.description: Whether veteran is the settlor/grantor and primary lifetime beneficiary

name: audit_veteran_living_trust_preservation
